3.10.name: Lucky Patch Handicap (Class 2) (Course C) (Turf)

3.10.spotlight_verdict: Victor The Winner (0 tips): Group 1 winner in his prime; plummeted down the weights this season but stopped the rot and caused 58-1 surprise over C&D in May (made all), and has since finished fourth off today's mark; Zac Purton keeps the ride; likely contender again. | Young Champion (0 tips): Still 7lb higher than for win at Sha Tin in March but has largely been consistent this year and was denied a clear run before keeping on for third at Sha Tin 11 days ago; each-way claims at least. | Son Pak Fu (0 tips): Led close home to exploit a reduced mark seven weeks ago, his eighth C&D success; still very well treated on older form but has wide draw and others have more appealing profiles. | Turquoise Velocity (0 tips): Progressive 4yo with 4-9 strike-rate, the latest win gained on soft ground at Sha Tin (6f) in May; below form on latest outing, though, and has double-digit draw to contend with today. | Sing Dragon (0 tips): Dual turf winner in Australia but all five local wins have come on dirt; didn't run badly over inadequate 5f last month and has good draw today but still not the percentage call.
